image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of several audio cassette tapes stacked on a textured surface. The primary subject is a transparent Philips MCX 90 cassette in the foreground, showing internal spools and printed text. A second cassette lies partially visible behind it, and a third (or its case) is at the top left. The image has a strong blue color cast and a vintage film border overlay with frame numbers and 'RVP100' text.

To verify if the printed text ('PHILIPS', 'MCX 90') is legible and correctly spelled, or if it suffers from AI-induced character deformation/gibberish.

focus_areas: Legibility and correctness of printed text on the cassette shell.
Structural integrity of the rectangular shape (straight lines, right angles).
Physical plausibility of the transparent casing and internal spool visibility.
Consistency of the film border overlay with the rest of the image.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the cassette. AI often fails to render small, curved, or perspective-distorted text accurately. Check if 'PHILIPS' and 'MCX 90' are perfectly formed. Also, scrutinize the transparency effect—does the background blur correctly through the plastic? The film border is a stylistic choice; ensure it doesn't introduce geometric inconsistencies to the actual cassettes.
